https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33364545/f0690ee3679e36606e8a3ce03627797acf6d3c05.jpg
Halloween arrives!
1. Halloween is coming! Night falls in the town. New festival scenes and ghost customers are approaching.
2. The Halloween carnival opens now. Prints and decorations are waiting for you.
3. Complete the Halloween quests to explore the haunted castle. Here comes an adorable maid. New Ghost Housekeeper Grace at your service!
4. Collect 7 Halloween items to unlock Ghost Skin for Grace 
5. Added new outfits: Bloodbat Priest Lynn, Demon Knight Carel and Dar Guardian Farune
6. Added Halloween ghost outfits for 12 heroes
7. Added Halloween dressings for shopkeepers and Halloween Decoration Gacha

Other Fixes:
1. Fixed the issue that the Archangel is not properly recommended in some Guild commissions.
2. Updated the requirements for shop order. The item limit is raised to level 30 now
3. Fixed the issues between Faction order and Guild order help

notes.title: Update Notice on Sep.13
notes.content:
Dear All,We're going to update new version on Sep.13.

Here is the incoming update as below:

1)New Features:
1. Adds Mid-Autumn festival events including holiday prints, new heroes and decorations.
2. Adds 3 rank common item prints. Upgrade the rank limit of working table
3. Robot Lv limit upgraded to 120. Craft limit upgraded to 100
4. Max level of Town building upgraded to 23
5. Max Level of heroes upgraded to 30. Max Level of craftmen upgraded to 22
6.Area II of exploration will be unlocked. Adds 3 new exploration regions.

2)Fixes:
Arcangel's 1st Skill will be changed into Born Leadership from Lucky Rune.

3)Incoming Mid-Autumn Events:
1. Adds Mid-autumn Carnival. You can use rune/token to swap corresponding gifts.
2. Adds 8 Mid-autumn prints. Collect 7 Mid-Autumn items for the Rabbit-Caer you can unlock the avatar of Rabbit Shopkeeper.
3. Adds new hero Fairy Rabbit-Caer. Complete all the festival events to unlock
4. Adds Mid-autumn decoration gacha. Tap Furniture - Gacha to find it.
5. Mid-autumn floor and wall paper will be for sale. Tap Furniture - Purchase to check it out.
6. Mid-autumn skin of reception desk will be for sale as welll. Tap reception desk - Skin to find it.
